I.value_zh: 指定的 project/CLI/lifecycle 源码、fcop.json、CHANGELOG、Git 历史、v3 spec、LETTER-TO-ADMIN 及命令输出。
I.value_en: Specified project/CLI/lifecycle source, fcop.json, CHANGELOG, Git history, v3 spec, LETTER-TO-ADMIN and command output.
I.notes_zh: 文件事实须在执行时取证，不在审定中补造。
I.notes_en: File facts must be evidenced at execution, not fabricated in adjudication.

O.value_zh: REPORT-003，含 Q1–Q4 结论、逐条证据、三选一/多选建议及附带发现。
O.value_en: REPORT-003 containing Q1–Q4 conclusions, per-item evidence, three-option recommendation and incidental findings.

A.value_zh: 只读检查初始化、迁移、仓库历史、spec/实现差异与 LETTER 的 Rule 0.c 风险，记录命令和输出。
A.value_en: Read-only inspect initialization, migration, repository history, spec/implementation differences and LETTER Rule 0.c risk, recording commands and output.
A.notes_zh: 审定不读取或执行被列文件。
A.notes_en: Adjudication does not read or execute listed files.

P.value_zh: ADMIN 指派；ME 核查并报告；后续选择保留给 ADMIN。
P.value_en: ADMIN assigns; ME investigates and reports; follow-up choice remains with ADMIN.

R.value_zh: P1、只读、四问题、每条结论需路径+行或命令+输出；无时限。
R.value_en: P1, read-only, four questions, each conclusion needs path+line or command+output; no deadline.

V.value_zh: Rule 0.c、v3 spec、项目源码/CLI、fcop.json、CHANGELOG 和 Git 历史。
V.value_en: Rule 0.c, v3 spec, project source/CLI, fcop.json, CHANGELOG and Git history.

C.value_zh: Q1–Q4 均有结论和证据、给 ADMIN 的三选建议、不得修文件；查不到写未验证。
C.value_en: Q1–Q4 each have conclusion/evidence, three-option advice to ADMIN, no file repair; unknown items say unverified.
C.notes_zh: 验收条件不等于结论已经形成。
C.notes_en: Acceptance conditions do not mean conclusions already exist.

B.value_zh: 不得修改任何 .md/.py；不得现场修发现的问题；不得用猜测填空。
B.value_en: Do not modify any .md/.py; do not repair discovered issues on site; do not fill gaps by guessing.
